verdict.rationale: Devin supports scheduling via MCP with cron expressions, one-time scheduling, and notification preferences, which enables rule-like automated triggering of Devin sessions on a schedule (devin-docs-17). However, this is limited to time-based scheduling rather than general event-driven rule definitions (e.g., triggering on arbitrary webhooks, code events, or custom conditions beyond schedules), and there's no evidence of a broader rules engine or conditional trigger system. missing for 10: evidence of arbitrary event-based triggers (not just cron/schedule), a documented rules/conditions engine, and independent confirmation that scheduled automations work reliably in practice.
